name: Hammerhead
description: Struck, bowed and blown physical modelling: marimba, vibraphone, xylophone and glockenspiel bars, kalimba tines, bells, glass, a steel pan, and plucked or hammered strings. A mallet, a bow (stick-slip friction) or a breath (jet) drives an 8-mode resonator bank with a tuned tube, or a waveguide string; buzz (kalimba bottle caps, balafon membranes), an LFO (free or synced) on strike position, hardness, stretch and pressure, per-hit randomness, pad aftertouch, swell, vibrato, decay, damping, mute and pedal, pitch drop, motor, body and room. 16 voices, 20 programs.
author: Groundswell
